metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully subscripted the '2' in 'H2O' in the document title using keyboard navigation (Home, Right, Shift+Right) and Ctrl+Shift+B, then saved with Ctrl+S.
metadata.capability_extraction: Agent can navigate text with keyboard, select individual characters, apply character formatting (subscript/bold), and save documents.
metadata.explanation: Composes the original subscript task with a second formatting objective: bolding the 'Fact sheet' heading. Getter reads the docx, checks for subscript on '2' in Title-style paragraph and bold on the Heading 1 paragraph. Partial credit: 0.5 for subscript, 0.5 for bold. Initial state passes negative control (neither property is set). [Fixed: renamed functions from invalid 8-char suffix 'f97dc4e5' to correct 32-char MD5 'fa57f784af7171fa0e677f21369b4177']

Fix 3: Updated evaluator func and result.type in task JSON to match new 32-char hash

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly retrieves the docx file from the container via env.controller.get_file and parses it with python-docx.
Subscript check correctly identifies runs with explicit font.subscript=True containing '2' in the Title-style paragraph, matching the instruction requirement.
Bold heading check correctly locates the Heading 1 paragraph containing 'Fact sheet' and verifies that at least one run has bold=True (explicit bold applied by user).
Using 'is True' (strict identity check) correctly distinguishes explicit bold/subscript from style-inherited (None) values, ensuring negative control resistance.
Partial scoring (0.5 per sub-goal) correctly rewards partial completion and ensures initial state (no subscript, no explicit bold) scores 0.0.
Rule validation errors in metadata reference old 8-char function names that were already fixed per fix_history; current tmp_funcs files use correct 32-char MD5 names.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: The bold_heading check returns True if ANY run in the heading is bold, not ALL runs. Consider iterating all runs and verifying bold=True on each to catch partial-bold scenarios more rigorously.
The rule_validation_passed=false entry reflects outdated names; consider re-running rule validation against the corrected function files to update this status.
